season_length.interpretation: Observed change in this satellite record. No cause is assigned: it can reflect fire activity, land use, the observing system, or chance.

season_start.interpretation: Observed change in this satellite record. No cause is assigned: it can reflect fire activity, land use, the observing system, or chance.

annual_total.interpretation: Observed change in this satellite record. No cause is assigned: it can reflect fire activity, land use, the observing system, or chance.

seasonality.definition: 10 %, 50 % and 90 % accumulation days of harmonised active cells per fire year

critical_weeks.rule: median weekly activity >= 50 % of the peak week

units.hotspots: number of fire pixels reported by the sensor (not comparable between sensors)
units.harmonized_cells: Aqua-MODIS-equivalent active fire cells per day (10 km cells x day/night half-days)
units.harmonized_frp_mw: sum over active cells of Aqua-MODIS-equivalent fire radiative POWER at overpass time, MW. An instantaneous snapshot, not an energy.

notes: Terra observes about three hours earlier in the day than Aqua. Terra-derived values are a statistical conversion across the fire diurnal cycle and are the least certain part of the record.
